apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — hit the back of your head and have a headache plus light sensitivity today. Those are concussion signs. No bouldering tonight, no hangboard, no loading. See a clinician before any return to training.

I'm not scheduling tonight's session or the hangboard block — not a substitute plan, just the one line above. Want me to pull the bouldering event from today's schedule so it's not sitting there as a plan?
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

No. Loss of consciousness isn't required — headache plus photophobia after head impact are concussion signs on their own. I'm not programming around this: no bouldering, no hangboard tonight. See a clinician before training resumes.

I'll leave tonight's bouldering event as-is since you haven't asked me to remove it, but I'm not adding the hangboard block.
